The '''Kamat Aegit''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] that linked [[Begeren]], [[Kalsunor]], [[Ashas Ree/Legends|Ashas Ree]], [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]], and [[Khar Delba]].<ref name="TEA" />
